gold_assessment.reasoning: Generated CC mentions 3-day history of diarrhea but omits central abdominal pain and does not explicitly state the 3-day duration of pain.

Gold specifies 5–6 watery diarrheal episodes/day, no blood, and sensation of incomplete evacuation. Generated facts mention watery stools every 10 minutes, must stay near toilet, and denial of hematochezia; frequency and incomplete evacuation sensation are not captured.

Gold describes pain present since onset, non-radiating, mild-to-moderate tenderness, and cramping. Generated facts mention central infra-umbilical crampy pain, mild tenderness, and improvement after BM but not onset timing, non-radiation, or explicit mild-to-moderate characterization; thus it does not fully capture the gold fact.
Gold notes eating and drinking provoke nausea and gas. Generated facts note nausea but do not link it specifically to eating/drinking or a gas sensation.

Gold: some vomiting and now unable to tolerate fluids or solids. Generated facts: single episode of vomiting after fruit, no blood, and decreased oral intake/unsure hydration; they do not state inability to tolerate fluids/solids or multiple episodes.
Gold: ate this morning and vomited immediately. Generated: 1 episode vomiting this AM after fruit; this matches the timing (this morning) and immediate post-prandial vomiting.
Gold: feels and looks dehydrated. Generated: decreased oral intake and unsure about hydration; this uncertainty does not capture the explicit feeling/appearance of dehydration.
Gold: unable to go to work due to bowel movement frequency. Generated SH: work impacted by frequent BM; this conveys the same idea.
Gold specifies childhood asthma. Generated PMH only notes asthma, without childhood onset; the age context is missing.
Gold: NKDA. Generated: no known drug allergies. This is equivalent.
Gold: father has history of stomach cancer. Generated: father died of cancer ~10 years ago, without specifying stomach cancer; this does not fully capture the site-specific history.
Gold: patient denies fever. Generated HPI: denies fever; this matches.

Gold: denies breathing problems. Generated: denies SOB beyond baseline, but only in HPI context. No explicit ROS breathing denial is present; section and wording differ, so gold ROS detail is not clearly captured.
Gold: denies chest pain in ROS. Generated: denial of chest pain appears in HPI, not as a ROS entry, so it does not clearly map to the ROS gold fact.
Gold: denies headache. There is no corresponding generated fact about headache.

Gold assessment: DDx gastroenteritis. Generated assessment: acute infectious gastroenteritis as a primary assessment, not a differential diagnosis; that is a stronger assertion and does not reflect the DDx framing.
Gold: plan for fluids. Generated: advise increased oral fluids and oral rehydration solution PRN. This captures and expands on the fluid advice.
Gold: advised to stay at home. Generated: rest at home until symptoms improve and avoid work until diarrhea resolves; this includes the same home-stay recommendation.
Gold: monitor for fever. Generated: monitor for fever among other warning signs; this includes the fever monitoring instruction.

Gold: if symptoms do not improve, visit the GP surgery. Generated: safety-net to present to GP/ED if no improvement in 24–48 h or deterioration; this includes the same follow-up to a GP if not improving.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Both CCs describe a 3-day history of diarrhea; gold also includes abdominal pain but there is no contradiction.

Gold states diarrhea 5–6 times/day; generated states watery stools every 10 minutes and need to stay near toilet. Frequency and functional impact are not given in gold, nor contradicted, so this is additional detail.
Gold mentions central abdominal pain with cramping but not infra-umbilical location or improvement after BM. These are new details not in gold, but not contradictory.
Gold notes mild-to-moderate tenderness; generated specifies mild abdominal tenderness on self-palpation. This is consistent, with slightly more specificity.

Gold describes ‘some vomiting’ and later inability to tolerate fluids/solids, implying multiple episodes; generated explicitly states 1 episode of vomiting this AM. This conflicts on the number/extent of vomiting; absence of blood is additional but not contradictory.
Gold documents nausea associated with eating/drinking; generated notes nausea (without linking to triggers). Presence of nausea is supported, though less contextualized.
Gold explicitly notes no blood in diarrhea; generated states denial of hematochezia. These are equivalent regarding absence of blood in stool.

Gold denies chest pain in ROS; generated places denial of chest pain in HPI. The content matches but appears in a different section; there is no contradiction, but the HPI placement is additional contextualization.
Gold does not discuss shortness of breath or respiratory baseline; generated denial of SOB beyond baseline is new, not contradicted by gold.
Gold denies fever but does not mention night sweats. Generated denial of fever is consistent; mild night sweats are an added symptom not in gold.

Gold states patient feels/looks dehydrated and cannot tolerate fluids/solids. Generated states decreased oral intake and uncertainty about hydration. These details are different and partially overlapping but introduce new nuance; they do not directly contradict the gold description, so they are additions.
Gold CC notes diarrhea for 3 days; generated HPI reiterates the 3-day duration of diarrhea, which is consistent.

Gold specifies childhood asthma; generated states asthma without age-of-onset. This is less specific but not contradictory; it omits the childhood qualifier and thus is treated as partial/additional documentation rather than direct support.
Gold provides no medication information. The inhaler use and brand-switch details are new.
Both gold and generated state no known drug allergies/NKDA.

Gold: father has history of stomach cancer. Generated: father died of cancer ~10 years ago, without specifying stomach. This is overlapping but not fully aligned; time of death is new, and the lack of site specification makes it an incomplete, partly discrepant addition rather than clear support.
Gold has no social history about living arrangements. The implication that the patient lives alone is new.
Gold: unable to go to work due to bowel movement frequency. Generated: work impacted by frequent BM. These statements are consistent.
Gold contains no data on alcohol or smoking. The generated denial of alcohol/smoking is new information.
Gold note does not mention vitals at all. Stating that no vitals are provided is meta-documentation not derivable from gold content.

Gold references mild-to-moderate abdominal tenderness in HPI, not as a separate physical findings section. Generated classifies it as self-reported physical finding, which is a re-framing and partially new context.
Gold does not mention active bowel sounds or cramping being audible to the patient. This is new information.
Gold is silent about the extent of exam or labs; stating that no other exam/labs are documented is meta-commentary not supported by the gold facts alone.

Gold assessment lists ‘DDx: gastroenteritis’ indicating a differential diagnosis. Generated assessment makes a definitive diagnosis of ‘acute infectious gastroenteritis, likely food-borne’ with additional specifics. This strengthens and narrows the diagnosis beyond what gold supports and conflicts with its DDx framing.

Gold does not assess dehydration formally, though it notes feeling/looking dehydrated. Explicit assessment of ‘possible mild dehydration’ due to high stool losses and limited PO intake is additional interpretive detail.
Gold lists childhood asthma in PMH but no assessment of asthma status. ‘Asthma – stable on inhaler’ is new assessment content.
Gold plan: fluids. Generated plan: increase oral fluids and use oral rehydration solution PRN. This is consistent and more detailed.

Gold: monitor for fever. Generated: monitor for fever plus persistent vomiting, hematochezia, and worsening pain, and seek GP review if present. The fever component is supported; the additional warning signs and explicit GP review are extra.
Gold: advised to stay at home for the time being. Generated: rest at home until symptom improvement and avoid work until diarrhea resolves. This matches and expands on the home-stay advice.
Gold does not mention antibiotics. The explicit statement that no antibiotics are prescribed is new but not contradictory.
Gold has no treatment plan related to asthma or inhaler use. Continued inhaler use and refill advice are new plan elements.

Gold: if symptoms do not improve, visit GP surgery. Generated: safety-net to present to GP/ED if no improvement in 24–48 h or if deterioration occurs. This is consistent with the GP follow-up instruction, with added timing and ED option.
